title: Tender Slovakian Dates Fold with Walnut Crust
description: A delicious post-workout dessert made with sweet dates, crunchy walnuts, and a hint of cinnamon. This vegan-friendly treat is perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth after a long workout.
instructions: In a food processor, grind the walnuts until coarsely chopped.
In a medium bowl, combine the ground walnuts, oats, coconut sugar, cinnamon, and salt.
Mix well until a crumbly mixture forms.
Add in the almond butter and vanilla extract, and mix until a dough forms.
Scoop the dough into a lined baking sheet, pressing it into a flat square.
Place the dates on top of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough over the dates, pressing the edges to seal the fold.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the dates are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Cut into squares and serve warm.
